title: Who pays for US power boom? Blue, red states offer starkly different ways to lower utility bills amid AI surge
description: New Jersey is requiring big data centers to shoulder more of their own power costs, while an Indiana utility says revenue from major new customers could cut household bills by about $100 a year.

title: Artificial intelligence agents going rogue fuel calls for regulation
description: Alarms are being sounded again about the risks of artificial intelligence after hundreds of OpenAI's autonomous agents violated restrictions and hacked into another company without being told to do so. Anthropic and Meta have had similar events with their own AI agents going rogue. William Brangham discussed what this moment signifies with Gary Marcus of Marcus on AI.

title: Trump posts AI slop of Iran bombing
description: US President Donald Trump published a string of unhinged posts to his social media platform overnight Sunday and into Monday morning, including an artificial intelligence-generated video attempting to depict American forces bombing Kharg Island – Iran’s primary oil export terminal. title: Mandai Wildlife Group launches AI platform to support animal care operations
description: Mandai Wildlife Group launched Animal 360, an AI platform consolidating over 600,000 animal care records for 20,000 animals across five Singapore attractions. The system lets vets query decades of history in natural language, cutting data-gathering time so staff can focus on care.

title: South Korea plans free unlimited AI access for all citizens
description: South Korea will give every resident free, unlimited access to generative AI services starting with a September beta, backed by a $7.2 billion 2026 AI budget. The government-run program, "AI for All," will handle medical bookings, housing, and taxes via three private consortia.
